products.name: Holo Fon
products.purpose: A TRYAMM-connected mobile device and interface concept for holographic communication, spatial media, creator tools, accessibility and secure access to the ecosystem.
plannedCapabilities: captions, sign-language relay compatibility and text-to-speech

products.name: Satellite Fon
products.purpose: A resilient communications concept for areas with weak or unavailable terrestrial coverage, intended to connect users, drivers, couriers, logistics teams and emergency contacts to TRYAMM services.
plannedCapabilities: low-bandwidth dispatch for rideshare, delivery and logistics
fallback synchronization when terrestrial service returns

accessibility.principle: Accessibility is a platform requirement, not an optional add-on.
supportedNeeds: users with limited mobility or one-hand use
users with cognitive, learning or neurodivergent needs

translation.principle: Language assistance must preserve meaning, privacy and user control.
plannedCapabilities: human-review escalation for legal, medical, financial and safety-critical content
original-text display and translation confidence notices
safetyRules: do not silently replace original text
do not rely only on machine translation for emergencies or binding agreements
do not expose private conversations to third parties without consent
allow users to correct preferred names and terminology
log translation errors affecting safety or money
